findings.affected_criterion: Full-profile recovery and future capability maintenance
findings.evidence: Captured config mutation is stated to fail closed without a profile qualification; section 7 requires future allowlist edits under full gates. Existing check_enrollment is invoked by candidate, tests, assessment, submit and publication, so an unconditional equivalent check would block full maintenance too. This is a confirmed specification tension, not an executed implementation defect.
findings.impact: A newly capability-enrolled task cannot update its allowlist even after full promotion, or implementers might relax the wrong enrollment boundary to escape the deadlock.
findings.remediation: Specify that captured enrollment/config bytes remain immutable; light requires live config equality, while explicit irreversible full promotion uses the original full suites and permits a separately reviewed config change as ordinary owned candidate content. Equivalent bounded maintenance semantics are acceptable.
findings.reverification: A fresh capability task editing the companion config must fail light; after promotion it must require full tests/current review and complete the full lifecycle without rewriting enrollment/history.

proof_obligations: Compare protected dependencies over the union of baseline tree and current worktree/index names, including staged deletions, untracked protected additions, modes and symlinks. Existing candidate source_names is current-only; do not use it alone as a baseline unchanged oracle.

Define actual changed-set scope explicitly: every published product change must be allowlisted; undeclared protected worktree edits must invalidate light execution, and unrelated unpublished prose must not silently become owned. Preserve exact commit-path/content enforcement and narrow generated-record exceptions.

Strictly validate enrollment 0.1 versus 0.2 fields; missing/unknown capability or selection state must not fall back to legacy/full silently. Original 0.1 remains full without rewriting bytes. Demonstrate deletion of each mirrored component and version downgrade rejection.

Bind selection record identity/hash and evidence into executed test proofs and final review. Reselecting the same candidate with changed rationale/evidence must invalidate earlier executions/review; promotion cannot replay old light proofs. Reviewer and final result must remain independently declared and candidate-bound.

Fixed checker must execute all three substantive assertions with nonzero coverage; modified checker/runtime/dependency bytes cannot qualify light. Retain current mandatory suite unchanged for this implementation task.

Exercise absent/failed evidence, author identity collision, replay across task/scope, stale candidate, config change/deletion, staged protected deletion, executable/symlink, promotion, and publication commit/destination mismatch. Preserve recoverable submit/finish state; local bare fixture is not actual configured remote evidence.
